bio.text: Sandra Scott represents House District 76 in the Georgia House of Representatives, having first run for the seat in 2010.
According to her legislative biography, Scott was born in Quincy, Florida, earned a B.S. in business management from Florida A&M University, and joined the U.S. Army in 1984.

The biography says she received her teacher certification from Armstrong State University, taught school for more than 20 years, and was a member of the Clayton County Board of Education beginning in 2008.
